precepts.text: I will declare the decree: the Lord hath said unto me, Thou art my Son; this day have I begotten thee. That is Christ. Ask of me, and I shall give thee the heathen for thine inheritance, and the uttermost parts of the earth for thy possession. See that? Heathen and Gentiles are the same meaning.
precepts.point: And make the desolate cities to be inhabited. Why do churches never read this kind of stuff? Why do apologists never read this type of stuff?

note.label: The Waters of Noah Will Be Fire

precepts.why:
The land of Israel is not going to be enough to hold all twelve tribes. The children left after the two-thirds were destroyed will say, “The place is too strait for me: give place to me that I may dwell.” So Isaiah says, “Enlarge the place of thy tent, and let them stretch forth the curtains of thine habitations: spare not, lengthen thy cords, and strengthen thy stakes; For thou shalt break forth on the right hand and on the left.” We are going to be so large we break out on the right hand and on the left.

“and thy seed shall inherit the Gentiles.” To inherit the Gentiles means to own them, to possess them. It starts with Christ first: “I will declare the decree: the Lord hath said unto me, Thou art my Son; this day have I begotten thee.” That's Christ.

“Ask of me, and I shall give thee the heathen for thine inheritance, and the uttermost parts of the earth for thy possession.” See that? Heathen and Gentiles have the same meaning. The Father gives the heathen to Christ for an inheritance, and Israel's seed inherits the Gentiles with him. Why don't churches ever read this kind of stuff? Why don't apologists ever read it?

precepts.text: Ask of me, and I shall give thee the heathen for thine inheritance, and the uttermost parts of the earth for thy possession. Thou shalt break them with a rod of iron. Be wise now therefore, O ye kings: be instructed, ye judges of the earth.
precepts.point: And ye shall take them as an inheritance for your children after you, to inherit them for a possession; they shall be your bondmen for ever. We were originally to have them as servants, but we sinned against our God and became their possession. It is going to go back to the way it is supposed to be.

note.label: The Colossians & The CHRISTIANS of America

precepts.why:
Leviticus 25:46 says of the heathen bondmen, “ye shall take them as an inheritance for your children after you”. Hold that, and hear Psalm 2: “Ask of me, and I shall give thee the heathen for thine inheritance, and the uttermost parts of the earth for thy possession.”

The Lord is saying, don’t worry, it is going back to that. He is going to give us the heathen for our inheritance. Meaning what? We are going to own them. That is what it is saying right there. We were their possession, but they were originally our possession; we sinned against our God and became theirs, and it is going to go back to the way it is supposed to be.

“Thou shalt break them with a rod of iron; thou shalt dash them in pieces like a potter’s vessel.” If they don’t want to get right, boom, upside the head. “Be wise now therefore, O ye kings: be instructed, ye judges of the earth.”

So the inheritance of Leviticus 25:46 and the inheritance of Psalm 2:8 are the same: the heathen given to Israel for an inheritance and a possession, ruled with a rod of iron.

precepts.text: The kings of the earth set themselves and the rulers take counsel together against the Lord and his anointed: the wicked elders allied with the heathen.
precepts.point: Behold, I lay in Zion a stone, a tried stone, a precious corner stone. Their covenant with death shall be disannulled. Today that covenant is the Christian pastors and Black politicians in bed with America, as the rulers then were in bed with Rome; and 'the report' they will not understand is Isaiah 53:1, that Christ is Messiah.

note.label: The Dividing Hatred: the Grafted in Strangers

precepts.why:
The rulers in Isaiah 28 said, “We have made a covenant with death, and with hell are we at agreement”. David shows who that covenant was with: “Why do the heathen rage, and the people imagine a vain thing?” The heathen rage, and the people, our people, imagine a vain thing.

“The kings of the earth set themselves, and the rulers take counsel together, against the Lord, and against his anointed”. They work together: the wicked elders and the heathen, against the Lord and against his anointed, his Son and his disciples.

So the covenant with death and hell is the rulers of Israel aligning themselves with the other nations, in an alliance with the heathen oppressors, even trying to save them. Back then the Pharisees, the scribes and the elders were in bed with Rome; in verse 19 they accepted Rome over Christ. Today it is the Christian pastors and your Black politicians in bed with America. That covenant “shall be disannulled”, and they shall be overthrown along with everybody else by Babylon.

precepts.text: The kings of the earth set themselves, and the rulers take counsel together, against the Lord and against his anointed.
precepts.point: The Pharisees took counsel with the Herodians how they might destroy him.

note.label: All Skinfolk Ain't Kinfolk: Children of Darkness

precepts.why:
“And the Pharisees went forth, and straightway took counsel with the Herodians against him, how they might destroy him.” The Herodians were a Jewish political faction that supported the Herodian dynasty and aligned with Roman rule for political stability. Herod was an Idumean, the same Idumeans the Maccabees fought against, set up as Edomite kings over us. And these Jews aligned themselves with the Herodians and the Romans ruling over us.

David saw it: “Why do the heathen rage, and the people imagine a vain thing? The kings of the earth set themselves, and the rulers take counsel together, against the Lord, and against his anointed.” The kings of the earth are the nations. The rulers are those of our people in the pockets, in the creature comforts, of white supremacy, heathen supremacy. Against the Lord and against his anointed: against Christ and his followers.

“Let us break their bands asunder, and cast away their cords from us.” Let us defame them, mock them, make them look bad, call them a hate group, call them racial idolaters. Cast away their cords: stop their teachings.

We have Herodians today: our people who desire and fight for the white man to reign over us by any means necessary. Officer Tatum, who said he would not cry over a loved one, then cried when Charlie Kirk died, and supports Israel. Mayweather too. Anton Daniels, who defends Trump to the death. Fresh and Fit, Charleston White, Candace Owens, jumping from one thing to the next with divided loyalties. Avery, crying over Charlie Kirk, a man who spoke evil of black people to the day he died. Jason Whitlock, who threw out the term racial idolatry.

These are financial idolaters. They worship money and the white man and the power he gives them financially. All skinfolk ain't kinfolk: like the Pharisees who took counsel with the Herodians against Christ, they take counsel with the kings of the earth against the Lord and against his anointed.

precepts.text: Be wise, O ye kings, and serve the Lord with fear.
precepts.point: A king shall reign in righteousness and princes rule in judgment.

note.label: Political Power Under Darkness

precepts.why:
“But the saints of the most High shall take the kingdom.” Who are the kings that will rule it? David speaks to them: “Be wise now therefore, O ye kings: be instructed, ye judges of the earth.”

We are the kings, and we are to be wise. We are the judges of the earth, brothers. Believe it or not, we are the judges. Right now we look like a bunch of nobodies, but the scripture says the earth was created for us, so we are the judges of the earth.

Read on: “Serve the Lord with fear, and rejoice with trembling.” That is how the kings and judges prepare to take the kingdom: by being wise and instructed now, serving the Lord with fear and rejoicing with trembling.

Isaiah shows the Lord restoring those judges little by little: “And I will restore thy judges as at the first, and thy counsellors as at the beginning: afterward thou shalt be called, The city of righteousness, the faithful city.” We have been whittled down, but we are waking up. Those are the judges, and the Most High is restoring us back again.

precepts.text: Out of Bethlehem shall come a Governor that shall rule the people Israel, which is Christ, the king the Most High set upon His holy hill.
precepts.point: Yet have I set my king upon my holy hill of Zion. Zion is another word for Israel, the term the Most High uses to refer to His people, and the king set upon the holy hill is Christ, set to be the ruler of His people Israel.

note.label: Psalm 2: Why Do the Heathen Rage

precepts.why:
“Yet have I set my king upon my holy hill of Zion.” Zion is another word for Israel, the term the Most High uses for His people, and the king set upon the holy hill is Christ. Matthew shows it: “And thou Bethlehem, in the land of Juda, art not the least among the princes of Juda: for out of thee shall come a Governor, that shall rule my people Israel.”

Out of Bethlehem comes a Governor that shall rule the people Israel. That Governor is Christ, the king the Most High set upon His holy hill, set to be the ruler of His people Israel. So even while the nations mock and oppress us and put us through all types of hell, He will have the last laugh, and His king is already set.

precepts.why:
“And ye shall take them as an inheritance for your children after you, to inherit them for a possession; they shall be your bondmen for ever: but over your brethren the children of Israel, ye shall not rule one over another with rigour.” The heathen are taken as an inheritance for our children after us, bondmen for ever; but over our brethren the children of Israel we do not rule with rigour.

So the promise stands, even though it has been delayed because our people broke the commandments. The heathen for an inheritance and the earth for a possession is what Christ asks of His Father, and it is what He gives to us, when He breaks the nations with a rod of iron.

note.label: Psalm 2: Why Do the Heathen Rage

precepts.why:
“Kiss the Son, lest he be angry, and ye perish from the way”. To kiss the Son means to worship the Son, who is Christ mentioned in verse seven. Peter gives the same warning from Moses: “For Moses truly said unto the fathers, A prophet shall the Lord your God raise up unto you of your brethren, like unto me; him shall ye hear in all things whatsoever he shall say unto you.”

“And it shall come to pass, that every soul, which will not hear that prophet, shall be destroyed from among the people.” That Prophet is Christ. Every soul that will not hear Him shall be destroyed, the same warning as kissing the Son lest you perish. Worship the Son and you are blessed; do not, and you perish when His wrath is kindled but a little.

note.label: Psalm 7: David's Prayer for Deliverance in the Last Days

precepts.why:
David asks the Most High to “Arise, O Lord, in thine anger, lift up thyself because of the rage of mine enemies”. Psalm 2 shows that rage: “Why do the heathen rage, and the people imagine a vain thing? The kings of the earth set themselves, and the rulers take counsel together, against the Lord, and against his anointed”.

The heathen rage and the kings take counsel against the Lord's anointed. That anointed is Christ, and now it is the followers of Christ. The same rage David felt from his enemies is the rage of the kings of the earth against the Lord and against his people.

So when David prays for the Lord to “awake for me to the judgment that thou hast commanded”, that judgment is redemption and salvation for his people. He prays for the sake of the Israelites that the Lord will return and bring judgment on our enemies.

precepts.why:
The fear that comes upon them turns into something. “Why do the heathen rage,” That fear turns into rage; that is why you see the things happening right now. The fear Edom has when they see us rising up turns into rage, and they start acting on that fear, creating laws to go against us. “and the people imagine a vain thing?” They are imagining a vain thing: the vain thing is all the lies being pushed out there that we are terrorists and so forth.

“The kings of the earth set themselves, and the rulers take counsel together,” These people are counselling together; they are literally sitting down in rooms behind closed doors, and guess who is the topic of conversation: you brothers and sisters here today, online, scattered to the four corners of the earth, waking up to the truth that you are Israelites. That is what the secret council going on right now is about. “against the Lord, and against his anointed,” Who is the Lord's anointed? We are the Lord's anointed; the anointed starts first and foremost with Christ, then all of us here. “saying, Let us break their bands asunder,” This is the key thing they are trying to do: they want to destroy these Israelite groups that are rising up. “and cast away their cords from us.” The cords are the teaching of Christ; they want that to stop. That is why they are trying to label the teaching of Christ, the teachings we teach, as hate speech, and once they label it hate speech they can say you can't teach that; you set up teaching on the street and they can shut you down, saying you are teaching hate speech and can incite riot or murder. That is what they are doing.

“He that sitteth in the heavens shall laugh:” You brothers and sisters have to read the scriptures; once you read them you understand everything that is going to take place. The Most High is laughing at them: you see what they are doing to my prophets? He is laughing at all the evil, the lies and the slander they are setting up against us, because the Most High has a plan; this battle we are in, the Most High is going to win for us. “the Lord shall have them in derision.” In derision, meaning confusion: you hear about impeachment, this and that happening around the world; the Most High is going to cause things to happen to remove their focus from us so we can keep doing his work. All that with the so-called impeachment of the president is the Most High doing that. So pay attention to what is going on and learn the scriptures. These classes are not to show you we know the scriptures; they are to build you up to know what is coming, so you can fight when the time comes, so when things happen you say, damn, the Bishop went over that last week; none of you in IUIC should be confused when things happen, because the Bible explains what is going to happen. The same way the Most High is laughing, you should be home laughing: look what these people are trying to do.
